verdict.rationale: The Jobs API documents that the language parameter is optional: when it is omitted, the language is auto-detected for each speech segment, so developers do not have to declare it. Per-segment detection also covers mixed-language audio, and explicit ISO 639-1 codes remain available as an override. Missing for 10: documentation of how the detected language is reported in the output, any detection accuracy or coverage details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the service can detect the spoken language automatically instead of requiring me to declare it

citations.quote: If not provided, the language will be auto-detected for each speech segment.
